name: One real spy travel or establishment turn; resumable

condition.code: local p=Players[Game.GetLocalPlayer()]; return p and p:IsTurnActive()
local a=ExposedMembers.JAC_PersonaBoundary.lastAction; if a=='ERROR_ADOPT_SPY' or a=='UNKNOWN_ADOPT_SPY' then error(a) end; return a=='IDLE' or a=='ACCEPTED_ADOPT_SPY'

steps.code: local b=ExposedMembers.JAC_PersonaBoundary; local s=b.ReadEnemy(); if #s.spyRoster.activeOffMap==1 then return 'TRAVEL' end; assert(#s.spyRoster.activeOffMap==0,'native travel roster ambiguous'); local t=b.EnemyTarget(); local p=b.Probe(t.owner,t.city); return p.canStart and 'MISSION_READY' or 'SPY_NOT_READY'
